instruction.text: Select the rock that is limestone.

atoms.b: Limestone is commonly formed from tiny fragments of ((++animal_shells sand)) and ((++fossils silt)).
Limestone can be ((++dissolved strengthened)) by acidic rainwater.
But rainwater can also react with the calcium carbonate in limestone to create a ((++protective destructive)) layer on the surface of the rock.
Limestone’s pale colour means that it ((++reflects absorbs)) heat well.
Limestone is ((less ++more)) durable than most other sedimentary rocks.
